text:
alex: quick ping — PR #27648 is green locally but CI is failing on the kv cache test. I need either a quick LGTM to rerun or eyes on whether we should update the snapshot. link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/27648 :eyes:

maria: can you paste the failing snippet? which test exactly?

alex: failing test name: `kv_storage_eviction_test`. log excerpt:
```
--- FAIL: TestKVEviction (0.42s)
storage_test.go:218: expected entries 32, got 31
stack: /pkg/cache/evict.go:47
```

sasha: thanks. that error smells like a nondeterministic eviction order — we've seen this crop up with longer runs. worth trying a targeted rerun first. if it fails again we should consider updating the snapshot only if the behavior is intentional. cc @sam for quick LGTM? :thumbsup:

sam: i can give a quick approve if the rerun passes. prefer not to change snapshots without repro. also what's the merge window for this?

alex: hoping to merge before the freeze at 18:00 UTC. CI queue might be slow. if rerun passes i can merge and watch canary.

maria: to make rerun clean, target the specific test shard: `./scripts/ci --shard=kv-3 --pattern=TestKVEviction` — that avoids blowing up other queues.

ci-bot: Rerun queued by alex for PR #27648 (target: kv-3, tests: TestKVEviction). ETA ~3m. :gear:

sasha: one more note — if rerun flakes intermittently we should add a small sleep in the test harness around eviction to stabilize ordering (follow-up issue ok). but let's not change production code in this PR.

ci-bot: Rerun finished: flaky-targeted-rerun RESULT = FAILED (1/1). failing assertion still reproducible. logs: https://ci.redwood/27648/build/12

alex: hmm. that suggests either infra nondet or test is brittle. i don't want to hold the merge for this unless it's blocking user-facing behavior. PR changes are unrelated to kv cache (pure doc + small hygiene).

maria: in that case, i'd prefer to update the snapshot + call it out in PR description, then merge after a single watch. sam — still OK to LGTM if snapshot update added?

sam: yes, add a note in the PR about the snapshot change and open a follow-up to track flaky eviction. i'll drop the LGTM once snapshot file added.

alex: done — added `kv_eviction_snapshot.golden` and a short note in the description and created issue #4127 to track flakiness. PTAL and lgtm please so i can merge before freeze.

sasha: looked at the snapshot diff, it's just ordering noise. i'll approve. :white_check_mark:

sam: LGTM. thanks alex.

ci-bot: Merge queued after approvals. Canary deploy will be observed for 30 minutes. Notifying eng-oncall if errors spike. :rocket:

alex: merging now, will DM if the canary shows anything odd — thanks all :heart:
